map.→ 打开数据增强有效量工具: -> Open the Data Augmentation Effective Volume tool
map.不算。它们与原始高度相关，对泛化的贡献低于等量真实标注数据；扩增主要起正则化作用: They do not count. They are highly correlated with the original data, so they contribute less to generalisation than the same amount of genuinely labelled data; augmentation mainly acts as a regulariser.
map.否。过度或不当增强(如旋转破坏方向语义)会引入噪声甚至错误标签，反而损害训练。应: No. Excessive or inappropriate augmentation (for example rotation breaking directional semantics) introduces noise or even wrong labels and therefore harms training. Judge by validation performance rather than by the number of augmentations.
map.填写「每种样本增强次数」。: Enter the "augmentation count per sample type".
map.增强主要缓解过拟合而非凭空创造独立信息，组合越多样增益越实在。: Augmentation mainly mitigates overfitting rather than creating independent information out of nothing, so a more diverse combination yields more real gain.
map.增强样本算独立样本吗？: Do Augmented Samples Count as Independent Samples?
map.小数据集应优先几何/颜色增强与混合策略(Mixup/CutMix)提升多样性。: Small datasets should prioritise geometric and colour augmentation plus mixup strategies (Mixup/CutMix) to increase diversity.
map.按增强变换组合与重复次数，估算数据增强后的等效训练样本量，辅助判断样本是否充足，: Estimate the equivalent training set size after data augmentation from the augmentation transform combinations and repeat counts, helping judge whether the samples are sufficient, which applies to small-dataset training, overfitting mitigation and augmentation strategy design.
map.数据增强的收益取决于\"新增样本带来多少新信息\"：若变换高度相似（旋转 1°）: The benefit of data augmentation depends on "how much new information the added samples bring": if the transforms are highly similar (a 1° rotation), the diversity coefficient approaches 0 and any amount of expansion is merely duplication; only a coefficient close to 1 counts as genuinely equivalent new data. Once the effective amount passes several thousand, the marginal benefit drops sharply.
map.理论扩充量 = 基数 × 增强倍数；有效等效量 = 基数 × [1 + (倍数: Theoretical expanded size = base count × augmentation multiplier; effective equivalent size = base count × [1 + (multiplier − 1) × diversity coefficient]
map.等效样本量≈原始样本×增强变换组合数×重复系数，但重复变换会带来相关性。: The equivalent sample size ≈ original samples × number of augmentation transform combinations × repeat factor, but repeated transforms introduce correlation.
map.：原始 1000 张，施加翻转/旋转/色彩 3 类各 2 档共 8 种组合 →: : from 1000 original images, applying 3 types of augmentation (flip / rotation / colour) with 2 levels each gives 8 combinations → equivalent ≈1000×8=8000 images. If the same transform is repeated 3 times, the effective gain is far below 3× because the samples are highly correlated.
